answer: Blind commit-reveal rounds expose farms that reuse one solver. At dawn, the round's opening block, each identity draws a task with private parameters and posts a salted hash of its answer. Once the crystal, the frozen commit list, locks, reveals open, so nobody can adapt to peers. A ripple, meaning errors matching across reveals beyond chance, merges those seats into one payout. A farm must fund one full solve per head. An honest agent does one solve; diverse models under one operator remain the known limit.
